text.description_html:
"UP" Style Pivot for Aluminum or Hollow Metal Doors

Replacement for Jackson 20-1685 "UP" center hung bottom pivot hinge set. Door Controls UP Pivot sets are designed for use with aluminum framed storefront doors or properly prepared wood and hollow metal doors up to 125 pounds.

Pivot bearing mounts to door threshold and/or floor plate. Bearing bracket attaches to bottom of door (Door Rail).

For Threshold & Floor Application - 1-1/2" (38 mm) Deep Bottom Door Rail

  • For Center Hung Doors up to 125 Lbs.
  • Height Adjustable
  • Full Ball Bearing Design
  • Jackson 20-1685 "UP" Pivot Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Packaged complete with bearing, floor mounting plate, bearing bracket, mounting anchors and screws.
